about: What AxStudio adds on top of Aris's package list (github.com/Descolada/Aris, assets/index.json). Read by AxStudio.Pkg.ahk and merged over the index, never written into it. categories: our own grouping, one package may be in several. packages: per package -- keywords added to its own, a description that replaces a thin one, notes shown beside it (warn: true shows them as a caution), snippets: ready lines of code, each {name, code}, and steps: what a rule (Logic > Rules) can do with it, each {verb, label, who, arg, code, sync} -- who is var, ctl or empty; code takes {who}, {arg} (the typed value, quoted), {path} (it as a path beside the script), {arg1} and {arg2} (its two halves either side of a |) and {g} (the window); sync: true calls AxBindSync() after, so what is bound to the value follows. fn: its most useful functions and methods, each {name, sig, does, returns}, read from its source -- offered as steps before it is even installed. src: where that was checked. hidden: left out, with a reason each (reasons). extra: packages Aris does not list, with what it needs to install them (install: anything 'aris install' takes). recommended: shown first, each {name, why} -- the ones that work well from rules and are easy to use without code. hidden: left out of the list (they build windows, which the studio does), with why.

Uberi/Yunit.notes: Tests are classes: each method is a test and fails by throwing (Yunit.Assert does that). The install step adds the output modules (YunitWindow, YunitStdOut, YunitOutputDebug, YunitJUnit) into Yunit.ahk. YunitWindow opens its own results window; YunitJUnit writes junit.xml beside the script. Test order is not fixed. Licence is AGPL-3.0.

owhs/ahksharp.description: Call any .NET method, create any .NET object and embed C# in AutoHotkey v2; NuGet packages, async, SQLite, HTTP and UI automation modules.

recommended.name: thqby/JSON
recommended.why: Reads and saves JSON files. Two rule steps, so a value can be loaded from a file and saved back without writing code.

recommended.name: Descolada/UIA
recommended.why: Clicks, types into and reads the buttons and boxes of other programs by what they are, not where they sit. Four rule steps.

recommended.name: Descolada/OCR
recommended.why: Reads the text off a window, an area or the whole screen, and clicks words it sees, with the OCR built into Windows.

recommended.name: iseahound/ImagePut
recommended.why: Takes a screenshot of the screen or a window and saves or copies it, in one step; can also tell whether a picture is on the screen.

recommended.name: Descolada/UIA_Browser
recommended.why: Drives Chrome and Edge: open a page, keep its address, switch tabs, go back. Four rule steps.

recommended.name: Descolada/WinEvent
recommended.why: Does something when a window opens, closes, comes to the front or is minimised, without checking over and over.

recommended.name: just me/SQLiteDB
recommended.why: A real database kept in a single file, for more data than a list or an .ini can hold.

recommended.name: evilC/TapHoldManager
recommended.why: One key, two jobs: a tap does one thing and holding it does another.

recommended.name: feiyue/FindText
recommended.why: Finds a small picture on the screen and clicks it, waits for it, or reads a colour -- fast and reliable, with its own capture tool.

recommended.name: G33kDude/cJson
recommended.why: The fastest JSON reader, for big files. The same two rule steps as thqby/JSON.

recommended.name: Descolada/String
recommended.why: Adds everyday text methods to every string -- Contains, Split, Replace and more -- in plain calls.

recommended.name: Descolada/Array
recommended.why: Adds everyday list methods to every array -- Sort, Filter, Map, Find -- in plain calls.

recommended.name: thqby/Audio
recommended.why: Sets the speaker volume, mutes, and sets the volume of one program such as a music player. Four rule steps.

recommended.name: SKAN/RunCMD
recommended.why: Run any command-line tool with no window and keep what it prints.

recommended.name: iseahound/TextRender
recommended.why: Flashes a message straight on the screen for a few seconds, over every window, in one step -- no window to design.

recommended.name: thqby/DownloadAsync
recommended.why: Downloads a file in the background while the window keeps working. One rule step.

recommended.name: thqby/WinHttpRequest
recommended.why: Fetches a web page or web API reply into a value. One rule step.

recommended.name: TheArkive/WinClip
recommended.why: Puts HTML or a picture on the clipboard, or saves the clipboard's picture as a PNG.

recommended.name: GroggyOtter/jsongo
recommended.why: Reads and saves JSON files with two rule steps, in plain AutoHotkey, and does not clash with other JSON libraries.

recommended.name: jNizM/Hash
recommended.why: Get the MD5 or SHA-256 of a file or text, to check downloads or spot changes.

recommended.name: Tigerlily/MonitorFind
recommended.why: Sets the screen brightness or dims the screen in one rule step.

recommended.name: JoyHak/Mouse
recommended.why: Set the mouse pointer speed or wheel scrolling from a rule with one number.

recommended.name: thqby/wincapture
recommended.why: Saves a picture of a window even when it is covered, and can wait until the screen changes.

recommended.name: lexikos/XInput
recommended.why: Make a game controller vibrate or check its buttons straight from a rule.
